description: Free start times of an experience, per group size, between two dates (at most 31 days at once, up to 90 days ahead; default: the next 14 days). Times are in the experience's time zone (Europe/Lisbon).

from_date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the experience's time zone.

group_size.description: single: price per person; small: a group of up to 4; large: a bigger group. Default: every size the experience offers.

to_date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the experience's time zone.

title: Check free dates and times
